1. Open Telegram and search for @BotFather.
2. Create a bot with /newbot and copy its token.
3. Send a message to your new bot.
4. Open api.telegram.org/bot<YOUR_TOKEN>/getUpdates in a browser.
5. Copy the id inside the chat object.

Never share your Bot Token. Group Chat IDs often start with -100.
